April 6, 2018 - By Linda Rogers 
Bank Of The West decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 2.19% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Bank Of The West sold 4,598 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 205,098 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $34.71 million, down from 209,696 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Bank Of The West who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $863.53 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.51% or $2.6135 during the last trading session, reaching $170.1865. About 11.80M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since April 6, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500. 
Cambridge Advisors Inc increased its stake in Oracle Corp (ORCL) by 183.01% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Cambridge Advisors Inc bought 18,978 shares as the company’s stock declined 4.18% with the market. The institutional investor held 29,348 shares of the prepackaged software company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.39 million, up from 10,370 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Cambridge Advisors Inc who had been investing in Oracle Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $185.54 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.11% or $0.51 during the last trading session, reaching $45.45. About 3.66 million shares traded. Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL) has risen 1.20% since April 6, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 10.35% the S&P500. 
Analysts await Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) to report earnings on May, 1. They expect $2.71 EPS, up 29.05% or $0.61 from last year’s $2.1 per share. AAPL’s profit will be $13.75 billion for 15.70 P/E if the $2.71 EPS becomes a reality. After $3.89 actual EPS reported by Apple Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -30.33% negative EPS growth.
